title: AI Safety Researcher Output
description: Strict schema for AI Safety Talent Sourcing Agent responses

query_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the search was executed

topic_focus.description: Topic categories included in the search

researchers.description: List of eligible researchers, sorted by relevance_score descending

location.description: City, Country (e.g., 'London, UK' or 'San Francisco, US')

relevance_score.description: Score from 0.0 to 1.0 based on topic match, recency, and evidence quality

topic_category.description: Whether the researcher focuses on direct or adjacent topics

key_topics.description: List of matched topics from the objective list

evidence.description: At least one verifiable source demonstrating topical relevance

title.description: Title of the paper, post, or project

url.description: Direct link to the source (arXiv, institutional page, etc.)

relevance_note.description: Brief explanation of how this source matches target topics (<15 words preferred)

profile_url.description: Link to researcher's personal website, institutional profile, or Google Scholar

confidence.description: Confidence level in eligibility and data accuracy

direct_topic_weight.description: Weight applied to direct topic matches (default: 1.0)

adjacent_topic_weight.description: Weight applied to adjacent topic matches (default: 0.6)

recency_decay_factor.description: Multiplier applied per year of recency (default: 0.95)

notes.description: Optional plain-text explanation of scoring adjustments
